REST API for the Delighted customer satisfaction platform. Enables sending surveys, retrieving and adding survey responses, accessing NPS and CSAT metrics, managing Autopilot drip campaigns, handling webhooks for real-time events, and managing people records including unsubscribes and bounces. Authentication is via HTTP Basic Auth using per-project API keys.
